item.title: ‘Toy Story 5’ Soundtrack Debuts in Top 10 on Three Billboard Charts
item.description:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: Welcome to our music update! We've got some exciting news from the world of Billboard. The Toy Story 5 soundtrack has debuted in the top 10 across three Billboard album charts, including a number one spot on the Kid Albums tally.
[Short music transition]
Host: The soundtrack, which features Taylor Swift's new original song "I Knew It, I Knew You", has also entered at number two on the Soundtracks chart and number nine on Independent Albums. Notably, it's also made its way onto the overall Billboard 200 albums chart, coming in at number 67, which is the highest-charting Toy Story album ever.
[Short music transition]
Host: For comparison, the first Toy Story soundtrack reached number 94 back in 1996, while the Toy Story 2 soundtrack peaked at number 111 in 1999. The Toy Story 5 album was released on June 19 and is currently available on streaming services and as a digital download, with a CD and vinyl release scheduled for September 18.
[Short music transition]
Host: And let's not forget the soundtrack's lead single, "I Knew It, I Knew You", which debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 songs chart, marking Taylor Swift's 15th number one hit. This song is also the first Hot 100 number one from a Pixar movie, joining an exclusive group of animated Disney films with chart-topping hits.
[Closing music plays]
Host: That's all for today's music update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!
